note: Both sets cover the same core drivetrain facts from Table 5-1 and the body text with correct values, units and quotes, and both keep the free-free-mode condition on the 5% critical damping ratio and the fully-deployed condition on the brake torque. Each set duplicates nearly every fact, stating it once under the NREL 5-MW turbine and again under the component (generator, rotor, gearbox, drive-shaft, brake). The only real difference is labeling: A calls the 0.6 s value a 'time constant' in both claims, while B distinguishes the text's 'time lag' from the table's 'time constant', a slightly more faithful but minor distinction. Neither set has a misread, misbound or invented claim.
remarks: Both extractions systematically emit each Table 5-1 row twice (turbine-level and component-level), inflating claim counts without adding information. Both omit supporting context facts on the page: the DOWEC basis for the 94.4% efficiency (0.35 MW loss at ~6.25 MW aerodynamic power), the DOWEC equivalent low-speed-shaft inertia of 5,025,500 kg•m2, the driveshaft natural frequency taken from the RECOFF model (no value given), the brake torque/time-lag basis from the DOWEC study, and the FAST/ADAMS linear ramp to full braking over 0.6 s. The 'gearbox frictional losses = 0' claim is a reasonable rendering of 'no frictional losses' but the page states it as an assumption, not a measured property.
